```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(leaflet)
library(sf)
library(crosstalk)
library(DT)
source("_data.R")

all_units <- az_all_levels()
counties  <- filter(all_units, level == "county")
statewide <- az_statewide(counties)
BUILD     <- statewide$file_date
early     <- az_early()
spread_by <- az_spread(all_units)
pp <- function(x, d = 1) sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f%%"), x)
```

## The Arizona Voter Project {.who}

The AVP provides **public-facing tools, data, and analysis** to understand the political, social,
and cultural characteristics of the Arizona electorate, with public resources to **access,
experiment with, and interact with** Arizona's voter file.

::: {.columns .quad}
::: {.column width="50%"}
### Data warehouse

Builds of the voter file over time, election records, Census data, and public opinion — secured under privacy protocols.
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
### Public data

Voting data aggregated to the boundaries people actually argue about: **counties, legislative and congressional districts, ZIP codes**.
:::
:::

::: {.columns .quad}
::: {.column width="50%"}
### Analysis

Tools and research that turn the data into answers about **who registers, who votes, and how**.
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
### Visualization

Maps, charts, and dashboards that make the results **understandable and easy to explore**.
:::
:::

# Registration {.divider background-color="#0C234B"}

## The electoral landscape {.landscape}

::: {.slide-note}
Figures are **active registered voters** on the latest voter-file build.
:::

```{r landscape}
#| fig-height: 3.3
land <- counties |>
  mutate(grp = if_else(unit %in% c("Maricopa", "Pima"), unit, "Other 13 counties")) |>
  group_by(grp) |>
  summarise(dem = sum(dem_n) / sum(registered), registered = sum(registered), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(grp = factor(grp, c("Maricopa", "Pima", "Other 13 counties"))) |>
  arrange(grp) |>
  mutate(share = 100 * registered / sum(registered),
         right = cumsum(share),
         left  = lag(right, default = 0),
         mid   = (left + right) / 2)

two <- sum(land$share[land$grp != "Other 13 counties"])

# reverse = TRUE so the stack reads Maricopa first, left to right.
# No `family=` on geom_text: the font is not registered with the graphics device
# and the labels are dropped silently when it is set.
ggplot(land) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = left, xmax = right, ymin = 0, ymax = 1, fill = dem),
            colour = "white", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_text(aes(mid, 0.68, label = grp),
            colour = "white",
            size = 6.4, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_text(aes(mid, 0.38, label = sprintf("%.1f%%", share)),
            colour = "white",
            size = 9.0, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_text(aes(mid, 0.13, label = sprintf("%.0f%% Democratic", 100 * dem)),
            colour = "white", size = 4.4) +
  # bracket under the two metro counties
  annotate("segment", x = 0, xend = two, y = -0.22, yend = -0.22,
           colour = "#AB0520", linewidth = 0.7) +
  annotate("segment", x = 0, xend = 0, y = -0.22, yend = -0.12,
           colour = "#AB0520", linewidth = 0.7) +
  annotate("segment", x = two, xend = two, y = -0.22, yend = -0.12,
           colour = "#AB0520", linewidth = 0.7) +
  annotate("text", x = two / 2, y = -0.46, size = 4.1, colour = "#AB0520",
           label = sprintf("Maricopa and Pima together: %.1f%% of active voters", two)) +
  # red = few Democrats, blue = many; midpoint is the statewide Democratic share
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#AB0520", mid = "#5A2A6E", high = "#1E5288",
                       midpoint = statewide$democratic / 100, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(-0.62, 1.05)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}

```{r landscape-left}
#| output: asis
pick  <- function(nm) filter(counties, unit == nm)
share <- function(nm) 100 * pick(nm)$registered / statewide$registered
mar <- pick("Maricopa"); pim <- pick("Pima")
cat(sprintf(
"- **Maricopa alone is %.0f%% of the state's active registration** — %s of %s active registered voters.
- Add **Pima** (%.1f%%) and two counties hold roughly three quarters of the electorate.
",
  share("Maricopa"), format(mar$registered, big.mark = ","),
  format(statewide$registered, big.mark = ","), share("Pima")))
```

",

## Registration in Arizona Counties {.mapsb}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="56%"}
```{r map}

# Diverging red - grey - blue: Republican margin red, Democratic blue, parity grey.
RGB_PAL <- colorNumeric(c("#1E5288", "#D6D8DA", "#AB0520"), domain = c(-45, 45))
LV <- c("county", "cd")

# No basemap. CARTO ended anonymous access and now stamps "API KEY REQUIRED" into
# the tile image itself, so polygons on white are used instead.
m <- leaflet(width = "100%", height = 520, options = leafletOptions(zoomControl = TRUE, zoomSnap = 0.25,
                                                    attributionControl = FALSE))
units_js <- list()

for (lv in LV) {
  d <- az_map_data(lv) |> st_transform(4326)
  grp <- unname(AZ_LEVELS[lv])
  units_js[[lv]] <- setNames(
    lapply(seq_len(nrow(d)), function(i)
      c(d$dem_n[i], d$active[i] - d$dem_n[i] - d$rep_n[i], d$rep_n[i])),
    d$unit)
  m <- m |>
    addPolygons(
      data = d, group = grp, layerId = paste(lv, d$unit, sep = ":"),
      fillColor = ~RGB_PAL(lean), fillOpacity = 0.85,
      color = "white", weight = 1.2,
      label = ~sprintf("%s — D %.1f%% · Neither %.1f%% · R %.1f%%",
                       unit, democratic, neither, republican) |> lapply(htmltools::HTML),
      highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 3, color = "#0C234B",
                                          bringToFront = TRUE)
    ) |>
    addLabelOnlyMarkers(
      data = suppressWarnings(st_point_on_surface(st_geometry(d))),
      group = grp, label = d$unit,
      labelOptions = labelOptions(noHide = TRUE, textOnly = TRUE, direction = "center",
                                  style = list("color" = "#1A1A1A",
                                               "font-family" = "Source Sans 3, sans-serif",
                                               "font-size" = "12px",
                                               "text-shadow" = "0 0 3px #fff, 0 0 3px #fff"))
    )
}

tot <- Reduce(`+`, units_js$county)
js_data <- list(state = as.numeric(tot), units = units_js)

m |>
  addLayersControl(baseGroups = unname(AZ_LEVELS[LV]),
                   options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)) |>
  setView(-111.9, 34.2, zoom = 6.5) |>
  htmlwidgets::onRender("
function(el, x, data) {
  var map = this, sel = {lv: 'county', name: 'Pima'};
  var cap = document.getElementById('sb-cap');
  var P = ['Democratic', 'Neither party', 'Republican'];
  var C = ['rgba(30,82,136,.80)', 'rgba(59,26,102,.55)', 'rgba(171,5,32,.80)'];
  var sum = function(a) { return a[0] + a[1] + a[2]; };
  var fmt = function(n) { return n.toLocaleString('en-US'); };

  function render() {
    var a = data.units[sel.lv][sel.name], t = sum(a);
    Plotly.react('sb-plot', [{
      type: 'pie', labels: ['Dem.', 'Neither', 'Rep.'], values: a, sort: false, direction: 'clockwise', rotation: 90,
      hole: 0.52, marker: {colors: C, line: {color: 'white', width: 3}},
      textinfo: 'percent', textfont: {size: 22, color: 'white'}, insidetextorientation: 'horizontal',
      pull: [0.02, 0.02, 0.02],
      hovertemplate: '<b>%{label}</b><br>%{value:,.0f} active<extra></extra>'
    }], {autosize: true, margin: {t: 10, b: 10, l: 10, r: 10}, showlegend: true,
         legend: {orientation: 'h', x: 0.5, xanchor: 'center', y: -0.02, font: {size: 16}},
         paper_bgcolor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', font: {family: 'Source Sans 3', color: '#0C234B'},
         annotations: [{text: '<b>' + sel.name + '</b><br>' + fmt(t), showarrow: false,
                        font: {size: 20}, x: 0.5, y: 0.5}]},
      {displayModeBar: false, responsive: true});
    cap.innerHTML = 'Active registered voters by party &middot; click any area to update';
  }

  // polygons are recognised by their hover label: unit name, then D share
  function bind() {
    Object.values(map._layers).forEach(function(l) {
      var c = l._tooltip && l._tooltip._content;
      var m = typeof c === 'string' && c.match(/^(.+?) — D /);
      if (!m || l._sbBound) return;
      var lv = data.units.county[m[1]] ? 'county' : (data.units.cd[m[1]] ? 'cd' : null);
      if (!lv) return;
      l._sbBound = true;
      l.on('click', function() { sel = {lv: lv, name: m[1]}; render(); });
    });
  }
  map.on('baselayerchange', function(e) {
    var lv = e.name === 'Congressional district' ? 'cd' : 'county';
    sel = {lv: lv, name: lv === 'cd' ? 'CD 6' : 'Pima'}; bind(); render();
  });
  // the widget fills in its layers only once the slide is shown, so keep binding
  // lift the selector out of the map into its own row above it, so it can never cover the state
  function lift() {
    var ctl = el.querySelector('.leaflet-control-layers');
    if (!ctl) return;
    var bar = document.createElement('div');
    bar.className = 'sb-selector';
    ctl.classList.remove('leaflet-control');
    bar.appendChild(ctl);
    el.parentNode.insertBefore(bar, el);
  }
  setInterval(function() { bind(); lift(); }, 500);
  setTimeout(render, 0);
  // the pie is first drawn while the slide is hidden, so redraw at full size once it shows
  function refit() { render(); Plotly.Plots.resize('sb-plot'); }
  Reveal.on('slidechanged', function() { setTimeout(refit, 350); });
  Reveal.on('ready', function() { setTimeout(refit, 350); });
}", data = js_data)
```

## Congressional District 6 {.smaller}

```{r cd6}
#| fig-height: 2.4
cd6 <- jsonlite::fromJSON("cd6-2024.json", simplifyVector = FALSE)
cand <- bind_rows(lapply(cd6$candidates, as_tibble)) |>
  mutate(party = recode(party, REP = "Republican", DEM = "Democratic",
                        GRN = "Green", IND = "Independent"),
         label = sub(",.*$", "", name))

reg6 <- filter(all_units, level == "cd", unit == "CD 6")

ggplot(cand, aes(pct, fct_reorder(label, pct), fill = party)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%  (%s)", pct, format(votes, big.mark = ","))),
            hjust = -0.06, size = 4, colour = "#4A5568") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Republican = "#AB0520", Democratic = "#1E5288",
                               Green = "#70B865", Independent = "#3B1A66")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 68), expand = c(0, 0), labels = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
       title = "U.S. House, CD 6 — November 2024",
       caption = "246 precincts across Pima, Cochise, Pinal, Graham and Greenlee.") +
  theme_avp(13) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r cd6-bullets}
#| output: asis
rep <- cand |> filter(party == "Republican") |> slice(1)
dem <- cand |> filter(party == "Democratic") |> slice(1)

# 2022 U.S. House, CD 6: AZ Secretary of State, 2022 General Election canvass
# (Results.Summary.xml), pulled via the azsos-results skill. Not vendored as its
# own JSON (cf. cd6-2024.json) — these four numbers are small enough to pin here
# with their source, rather than add a second data file for one slide.
c22_rep_votes <- 177201L; c22_rep_pct <- 50.73
c22_dem_votes <- 171969L; c22_dem_pct <- 49.23
c22_margin    <- c22_rep_votes - c22_dem_votes
c22_total     <- 349283L

cat(sprintf(
"- This is the **Giffords seat** -- redrawn -- which has remained compettitive. Gabrielle Giffords (CD 8, 2007–2012), Ron Barber (CD 8 special, then CD 2), Martha McSally (CD 2, 2015–2019) and Ann Kirkpatrick (CD 2, 2019–2023) — renumbered CD 6 for the 2022 cycle, when Juan Ciscomani first won it.
- **2024:** %s (R) %.1f%% to %s (D) %.1f%% — a margin of **%s votes** on %s cast.
- **2022:** Ciscomani (R) %.2f%% to Engel (D) %.2f%% — a margin of **%s votes** on %s cast, the seat's first election under the new boundaries. *AZ SoS 2022 General Election canvass.*
- Registration in CD 6 today: **%.1f%%** Democratic · **%.1f%%** neither party · **%.1f%%** Republican. 
",
  rep$label, rep$pct, dem$label, dem$pct,
  format(rep$votes - dem$votes, big.mark = ","), format(cd6$total_votes, big.mark = ","),
  c22_rep_pct, c22_dem_pct, format(c22_margin, big.mark = ","), format(c22_total, big.mark = ","),
  reg6$democratic, reg6$neither, reg6$republican))
```

## Congressional District 6, over time {.cdtrend .nostretch}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="66%"}

```{r cd6-trend}
#| fig-width: 8.6
#| fig-height: 5.6
#| out-width: "100%"
tr6 <- az_cd_trend("AZ-CD-06") |> mutate(district = "CD 6")
tr7 <- az_cd_trend("AZ-CD-07") |> mutate(district = "CD 7")

long <- bind_rows(tr6, tr7) |>
  select(build, district,
         Democratic      = total_democratic,
         `Neither party` = neither_n,
         Republican      = total_republican) |>
  pivot_longer(-c(build, district), names_to = "group", values_to = "n") |>
  mutate(group = factor(group, names(AVP_COL)))

last <- long |> filter(district == "CD 6") |> group_by(group) |>
  slice_max(build, n = 1) |> ungroup()

ggplot(long, aes(build, n, colour = group, alpha = district,
                 group = interaction(district, group))) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_point(size = 2.6) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = last,
    aes(x = build, y = n, colour = group,
        label = format(round(n), big.mark = ",")),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    direction = "y",
    nudge_x = 20,
    hjust = 0,
    size = 4.2,
    fontface = "bold",
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    segment.color = "#5A6470",
    segment.alpha = 0.8,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    seed = 17,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = AVP_COL, name = "Party") +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("CD 6" = 1, "CD 7" = 0.22), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %Y",
               expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.12))) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma(),
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(5)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Active registered voters (count)",
       title = "Active registered voters by party: CD 6 and CD 7",
       subtitle = "CD 6 is solid; CD 7 is faint. Dips reflect voter-file maintenance.",
       caption = sprintf("%d builds, %s to %s.",
                         nrow(tr6), format(min(tr6$build), "%b %Y"), format(max(tr6$build), "%b %Y"))) +
  theme_avp(16) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

## Registration, by County {.regtable}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="58%"}

```{r reg-table}
tbl <- counties |>
  transmute(County = unit, `Active registered` = registered,
            Democratic = democratic, `Neither party` = neither,
            Republican = republican) |>
  arrange(desc(`Active registered`))

# Use one scale across party columns so equal percentages have equal bar lengths.
bar <- function(fill) styleColorBar(c(0, 60), fill)

tbl |>
  datatable(
    rownames = FALSE,
    options = list(dom = "t", paging = FALSE, ordering = TRUE,
                   scrollY = FALSE,
                   columnDefs = list(list(className = "dt-right", targets = 1:4))),
    class = "compact hover"
  ) |>
  formatRound("Active registered", digits = 0, mark = ",") |>
  formatRound(c("Democratic", "Neither party", "Republican"), digits = 1) |>
  formatStyle("Democratic", background = bar("#BFD0E4"),
              backgroundSize = "94% 62%", backgroundRepeat = "no-repeat",
              backgroundPosition = "center") |>
  formatStyle("Neither party", background = bar("#BBA6D8"),
              backgroundSize = "94% 62%", backgroundRepeat = "no-repeat",
              backgroundPosition = "center") |>
  formatStyle("Republican", background = bar("#EFC2C6"),
              backgroundSize = "94% 62%", backgroundRepeat = "no-repeat",
              backgroundPosition = "center")
```

:::
::: {.column width="42%"}

```{r range-bullets}
#| output: asis
cs <- filter(spread_by, level_name == "County")
g  <- function(x) filter(cs, group == x)
rng <- function(x) {
  r <- g(x)
  sprintf("**%.0f points** — %.1f%% in %s to %.1f%% in %s",
          r$range, r$min, r$lo_unit, r$max, r$hi_unit)
}
cat(sprintf(
"- Statewide: **%.1f%%** Democratic · **%.1f%%** neither party · **%.1f%%** Republican
- Democratic across counties spans %s
- Republican spans almost exactly as much: %s
- **Neither party** spans only %s
",
  statewide$democratic, statewide$neither, statewide$republican,
  rng("Democratic"), rng("Republican"), rng("Neither party")))

party_rng <- mean(c(g("Democratic")$range, g("Republican")$range))
none_rng  <- g("Neither party")$range
cat(sprintf(
"\n::: {.takeaway}\n**%.0f points against %.0f.** Each party's share varies about %.1f times as much across Arizona as the share registered with neither.\n:::\n",
  party_rng, none_rng, party_rng / none_rng))
```

## Registration, by Congressional District {.regtable .cdmap}

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="56%"}

```{r cd-table}
cds <- all_units |> filter(level == "cd") |>
  mutate(num = as.integer(sub("CD ", "", unit))) |> arrange(num)
bar_cell <- function(v, col) sprintf(
  '<td class="num" data-v="%.4f" style="background:linear-gradient(90deg,%s %.1f%%,transparent %.1f%%)">%.1f</td>',
  v, col, v / 60 * 94, v / 60 * 94, v)
rows <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(cds)), function(i) with(cds[i, ], sprintf(
  '<tr data-unit="%s"><td data-v="%d">%s</td><td class="num" data-v="%d">%s</td>%s%s%s</tr>',
  unit, num, unit, registered, format(registered, big.mark = ","),
  bar_cell(democratic, "#BFD0E4"), bar_cell(neither, "#BBA6D8"), bar_cell(republican, "#EFC2C6"))),
  character(1))
htmltools::HTML(paste0(
  '<table id="cd-tbl"><thead><tr><th>District</th><th class="num">Active registered</th>',
  '<th class="num">Democratic</th><th class="num">Neither party</th><th class="num">Republican</th></tr></thead><tbody>',
  paste(rows, collapse = ""), '</tbody></table>'))
```

:::
::: {.column width="44%"}

```{r cd-map}
dm <- az_map_data("cd") |> st_transform(4326)
leaflet(dm, width = "100%", height = 380,
        options = leafletOptions(zoomControl = FALSE, attributionControl = FALSE,
                                 dragging = FALSE, scrollWheelZoom = FALSE,
                                 doubleClickZoom = FALSE, boxZoom = FALSE,
                                 keyboard = FALSE, zoomSnap = 0.1)) |>
  addPolygons(layerId = ~unit, fillColor = "#FFFFFF", fillOpacity = 1,
              color = "#000000", weight = 1,
              label = ~unit, labelOptions = labelOptions(direction = "auto")) |>
  fitBounds(st_bbox(dm)[[1]], st_bbox(dm)[[2]], st_bbox(dm)[[3]], st_bbox(dm)[[4]]) |>
  htmlwidgets::onRender("
function(el, x) {
  var map = this, layers = {}, cur = null;
  function paint(name) {
    Object.keys(layers).forEach(function(k) {
      var on = k === name;
      layers[k].setStyle({fillColor: on ? '#000000' : '#FFFFFF', weight: on ? 2.5 : 1});
      if (on) layers[k].bringToFront();
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('#cd-tbl tbody tr').forEach(function(r) {
      r.classList.toggle('sel', r.dataset.unit === name);
    });
    cur = name;
  }
  var fresh = false;
  function wire() {
    fresh = false;
    map.eachLayer(function(l) {
      var name = l._tooltip && l._tooltip._content;
      if (typeof name === 'string' && l.setStyle && !l._cdBound) {
        l._cdBound = true; fresh = true; layers[name] = l;
        l.on('click', function() { paint(name); });
      }
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('#cd-tbl tbody tr').forEach(function(r) {
      if (r._cdBound) return;
      r._cdBound = true;
      r.addEventListener('click', function() { paint(r.dataset.unit); });
    });
  }
  function refit() {
    map.invalidateSize();
    if (Object.keys(layers).length) map.fitBounds(L.featureGroup(Object.values(layers)).getBounds(), {padding: [4, 4]});
  }
  // click a column header to sort; click again to reverse
  var sortCol = -1, asc = true;
  document.querySelectorAll('#cd-tbl thead th').forEach(function(th, i) {
    th.style.cursor = 'pointer';
    th.addEventListener('click', function() {
      asc = (sortCol === i) ? !asc : (i === 0);
      sortCol = i;
      var tb = document.querySelector('#cd-tbl tbody');
      Array.from(tb.rows).sort(function(a, b) {
        var d = a.cells[i].dataset.v - b.cells[i].dataset.v;
        return asc ? d : -d;
      }).forEach(function(r) { tb.appendChild(r); });
      document.querySelectorAll('#cd-tbl thead th').forEach(function(h, j) {
        h.textContent = h.textContent.replace(/ [▲▼]$/, '');
        if (j === i) h.textContent += asc ? ' ▲' : ' ▼';
      });
    });
  });
  wire(); paint(cur || 'CD 6');
  // layers arrive only once the slide is shown, so keep wiring until they do
  setInterval(function() {
    wire();
    if (fresh) { paint(cur || 'CD 6'); refit(); }
  }, 500);
  Reveal.on('slidechanged', function() { setTimeout(refit, 350); });
  Reveal.on('ready', function() { setTimeout(refit, 350); });
}")
```

:::
:::

```{r cd-bullets}
#| output: asis
cs <- filter(spread_by, level_name == AZ_LEVELS[["cd"]])
g  <- function(x) filter(cs, group == x)
rng <- function(x) {
  r <- g(x)
  sprintf("%.0f points (%.1f%% in %s to %.1f%% in %s)", r$range, r$min, r$lo_unit, r$max, r$hi_unit)
}
cat(sprintf(
"- **Partisan differences are large:** Democratic registration range %s; Republican range %s.
- **Neither party is less variable:** its range is only %s across the nine districts.
",
  rng("Democratic"), rng("Republican"), rng("Neither party")))
```

# How Arizonans vote {.divider background-color="#0C234B"}

## Early voting is the norm {.statcard}

::: {.card-head}
Statewide · `r BUILD` build
:::

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="34%"}
### `r pp(early$enrolment$share)`

on the **Active Early Voting List** — a ballot arrives automatically, every election.
:::
::: {.column width="33%"}
### `r pp(filter(early$overall, period == "2024-11-05")$share)`

of ballots in the **November 2024 general** were cast early.
:::
::: {.column width="33%"}
### `r pp(filter(early$overall, period == "2026-07-21")$share)`

of ballots in the **July 2026 primary** were cast early.
:::
:::

::: {.fragment .smaller}
“Early” covers three different acts — returned by mail, dropped at a secure box, or voted
in person before Election Day.
:::

## There is a partisan difference

```{r early-party}
#| fig-height: 4.2
bp <- early$by_party |>
  mutate(party = factor(party, c("Democratic", "Republican", "Other"),
                        labels = c("Democratic", "Republican", "Neither / other")),
         election = factor(period, c("2024-11-05", "2026-07-21"),
                           labels = c("November 2024 general", "July 2026 primary")))
cols <- c(Democratic = "rgba(30,82,136,0.55)", Republican = "rgba(171,5,32,0.55)",
          `Neither / other` = "rgba(59,26,102,0.55)")
lines <- c(Democratic = "#1E5288", Republican = "#AB0520", `Neither / other` = "#3B1A66")

p <- plot_ly(width = 1120, height = 400)
for (g in names(cols)) {
  d <- filter(bp, party == g)
  p <- add_bars(p, data = d, x = ~election, y = ~share, name = g,
                text = sprintf("%.1f%%", d$share), textposition = "outside",
                textfont = list(size = 18, color = "#1B2A4A"),
                marker = list(color = lines[[g]], line = list(width = 0)),
                hovertemplate = paste0(g, ": %{y:.1f}%<extra></extra>"))
}
p |>
  layout(barmode = "group", bargap = 0.3, bargroupgap = 0.06,
         xaxis = list(title = "", tickfont = list(size = 16)),
         yaxis = list(title = "Share of ballots cast early", ticksuffix = "%",
                      range = c(0, 108), tickfont = list(size = 14)),
         legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0.5, xanchor = "center", y = -0.12,
                       yanchor = "top", font = list(size = 16), entrywidth = 170),
         font = list(family = "Source Sans 3"),
         margin = list(t = 30, b = 70)) |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
```

::: {.smaller}
- **Democratic registrants lead on early voting:** `r sprintf("%.1f%%", filter(bp, party == "Democratic", period == "2026-07-21")$share)` of their July 2026 primary ballots were cast early, versus `r sprintf("%.1f%%", filter(bp, party == "Republican", period == "2026-07-21")$share)` for Republicans.
- **The gap is more pronounced in the primary:** Democrats were `r sprintf("%.1f", filter(bp, party == "Democratic", period == "2026-07-21")$share - filter(bp, party == "Republican", period == "2026-07-21")$share)` points ahead of Republicans, up from `r sprintf("%.1f", filter(bp, party == "Democratic", period == "2024-11-05")$share - filter(bp, party == "Republican", period == "2024-11-05")$share)` in November 2024.
- **Neither party / other trails** (`r sprintf("%.1f%%", filter(bp, party == "Neither / other", period == "2026-07-21")$share)` in the primary). Independents must **ask for** a party ballot in the primary, which depresses their early share.
:::

## Registration as a share of citizens of voting age {.smaller}

```{r pop-rate}
#| fig-height: 3.4
rate <- az_registration_rate()
vap_2024 <- 100 * AZ_2024_CANVASS$ballots_cast / rate$vap[1]
cvap <- rate$vap[1]
ylim <- c(50, 90)
cnt_ticks <- seq(3e6, 5e6, by = 5e5)  # counts that fall inside ylim * CVAP
cnt_ticks <- cnt_ticks[cnt_ticks / cvap * 100 >= ylim[1] & cnt_ticks / cvap * 100 <= ylim[2]]
plot_ly(rate, x = ~build, width = 1000, height = 300) |>
  add_trace(y = ~rate, type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
            name = "Active registrants, % of CVAP",
            line = list(color = "#1E5288", width = 4),
            marker = list(color = "#1E5288", size = 9),
            hovertemplate = "%{y:.1f}% of citizen voting-age population<extra>%{x|%b %Y}</extra>") |>
  add_trace(y = ~active, yaxis = "y2", type = "scatter", mode = "lines",
            line = list(color = "rgba(0,0,0,0)"), showlegend = FALSE,
            hovertemplate = "%{y:,.0f} active registrants<extra>%{x|%b %Y}</extra>") |>
  add_trace(y = ~turnout24, type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
            name = "Voted in Nov 2024, % of registrants in each build",
            line = list(color = "#EF9B20", width = 4),
            marker = list(color = "#EF9B20", size = 9),
            hovertemplate = "%{y:.1f}% of registrants voted in Nov 2024<extra>%{x|%b %Y}</extra>") |>
  layout(shapes = list(list(type = "line", xref = "paper", x0 = 0, x1 = 1,
                            yref = "y", y0 = vap_2024, y1 = vap_2024,
                            line = list(color = "rgba(171,5,32,0.35)", width = 3, dash = "dot"))),
         annotations = list(list(xref = "paper", x = 0.93, xanchor = "right",
                                 yref = "y", y = vap_2024, yanchor = "bottom", showarrow = FALSE,
                                 text = sprintf("Nov 2024 general: ballots cast = %.1f%% of CVAP", vap_2024),
                                 font = list(size = 15, color = "rgba(171,5,32,0.8)"))),
         legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0.5, xanchor = "center", y = -0.1, yanchor = "top",
                       font = list(size = 15), entrywidth = 420),
         xaxis = list(title = "", tickformat = "%b %Y", tickfont = list(size = 15)),
         yaxis = list(title = "Percent", ticksuffix = "%",
                      range = ylim, tickfont = list(size = 14)),
         yaxis2 = list(overlaying = "y", side = "right", showgrid = FALSE,
                       title = "Active registrants (count)",
                       range = ylim / 100 * cvap, tickvals = cnt_ticks,
                       ticktext = sprintf("%.1fM", cnt_ticks / 1e6),
                       tickfont = list(size = 14)),
         font = list(family = "Source Sans 3"),
         margin = list(t = 20, r = 70, b = 90)) |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
```

::: {.smaller}
- **Active registrants** were `r sprintf("%.1f%%", rate$rate[1])` of Arizona's citizen voting-age population (CVAP) in `r format(rate$build[1], "%b %Y")`, peaked at `r sprintf("%.1f%%", max(rate$rate))` in `r format(rate$build[which.max(rate$rate)], "%b %Y")`, and stood at `r sprintf("%.1f%%", tail(rate$rate, 1))` in `r format(tail(rate$build, 1), "%b %Y")`. 
- **Voted in Nov 2024 (gold line):** each build's `turnout_gen_2024` field, weighted by active registrants: `r sprintf("%.1f%%", rate$turnout24[1])` in `r format(rate$build[1], "%b %Y")` to `r sprintf("%.1f%%", tail(rate$turnout24, 1))` in `r format(tail(rate$build, 1), "%b %Y")`. Its base is the registrants in that build, not CVAP, so it is not directly comparable to the blue line.
- **Turnout benchmark (transparent line):** the Secretary of State's official canvass counts `r format(AZ_2024_CANVASS$ballots_cast, big.mark = ",")` ballots cast in the November 2024 general, or **`r sprintf("%.1f%%", vap_2024)`** of citizen voting-age population (`r sprintf("%.1f%%", AZ_2024_CANVASS$turnout_registered)` of those registered).
- Source: U.S. Census Bureau, ACS `r rate$vap_year[1]` 1-year estimates, citizens 18 and over (`r format(rate$vap[1], big.mark = ",")`). Canvass: Arizona Secretary of State. The same CVAP is used for every build, which ensures consistency across all visualizations.
:::

## {.conclusion background-color="#0C234B"}

::: {.kicker}
Conclusion
:::

::: {.headline}
Concluding remarks
:::

::: {.takeaways}
1. **Registration is concentrated.** Maricopa and Pima hold `r sprintf("%.0f%%", two)` of active registrants.
2. **No party holds a majority.** Statewide, active voters are `r sprintf("%.0f%%", statewide$republican)` Republican, `r sprintf("%.0f%%", statewide$democratic)` Democratic, and `r sprintf("%.0f%%", statewide$neither)` neither party.
3. **Arizona votes early.** `r pp(filter(early$overall, period == "2024-11-05")$share, 0)` of November 2024 ballots were cast early, and `r pp(early$enrolment$share, 0)` of voters are on the early list.
4. **Participation has room to grow.** Active registrants peaked at `r sprintf("%.0f%%", max(rate$rate))` of citizens of voting age, and `r sprintf("%.0f%%", vap_2024)` cast a ballot in 2024.
:::

# Backup {.divider background-color="#0C234B"}

## Data {.smaller}

- **Voter file:** `r length(AZ_BUILDS)` monthly builds of Arizona's voter file, `r format(min(AZ_BUILDS))` to `r BUILD`. Party shares are of **active** registered voters; "neither" is everyone not registered Democratic or Republican.
- **Aggregation:** all figures are aggregates; units with fewer than 500 registrants are suppressed.
- **Population:** U.S. Census Bureau, ACS `r rate$vap_year[1]` 1-year estimates, table B29001 (citizens 18 and over, `r format(rate$vap[1], big.mark = ",")`), applied to every build.
- **2024 turnout:** Arizona Secretary of State official canvass, November 2024 general (`r format(AZ_2024_CANVASS$ballots_cast, big.mark = ",")` ballots cast).
- **Early voting:** ballots cast early and the Active Early Voting List, from the voter file builds.
- **Election Administration and Voting Survey (EAVS):** reports a slightly different 2024 ballot count than the state canvass; the canvass is used here.
- **Congressional District 6:** 2024 results from the Secretary of State canvass.
